improvement.title: Durable exact-proof verified STATUS synchronization
improvement.integrationMode: Ferrum-native governance/evidence synchronization workflow and script
improvement.problem: Ferrum STATUS could lag a newer fully verified evolution product and shallow pull-request checkouts initially prevented provenance tests from seeing historical verified commit objects.
solution: Select the newest fully verified evolution product reachable from current main rather than hard-coding a prior run.

Require exact tested proposal/product tree equality, current-main ancestry, successful Ferrum CI, required artifact presence/provider digests, and successful declared companion workflows on the exact proposal head.
Fetch full main history only when a provenance test is running in a shallow checkout, preserving the existing ancestry and exact-tree checks rather than weakening them.
Preserve prior verified checkpoints, keep STATUS synchronization byte-idempotent when the selected identity is unchanged, and fail closed when concurrent branch state diverges.
improvement.expectedBenefit: Eliminate stale verified-product pointers while preventing incomplete or mismatched proof from being promoted into durable project state.

beforeAfterEvidence.before: STATUS still pointed at an older verified product after later verified evolution merges; the first current-head provenance test failed in shallow PR checkout because historical objects were absent.
beforeAfterEvidence.after: Exact head 94a497d completed every affected workflow successfully with the shallow-history repair, and merge commit 82170af has no file/tree difference from the tested proposal head.

independentChallenge.reason: The STATUS repair already cleared a broad exact-head gate and merged. The PTY/TUI candidates need a new real Linux/Windows workload before product integration; adding a dependency now would be speculative. The next improvement should be an isolated adapter experiment, not a direct node-pty dependency or terminal-emulator rewrite.
